profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and traded under the ticker XPEV, with CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish site presents the XPENG España range of fully electric vehicles and states that the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The site lists three models, the G6, G9 and P7+, and describes them as combining artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the 800-volt SEPA 2.0 electric platform, which the company says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km. The site invites visitors to leave their details to arrange a test drive or ask for more information.

The site gives a financing example for the G6 RWD Standard Range at a cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €, with financing offered by Open Bank, S.A. It names CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. as the data controller for enquiries submitted through the page. No lawsuits are noted for the company, and no products beyond the vehicles described on the site are listed.
